name: Get Ticket Comments
plugin_description: Integrates with Zendesk to manage support tickets from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Fetches a ticket's conversation thread, pre-flattened into one formatted transcript for downstream LLM steps, plus the most recent comment on its own.

inputs.name: public_only
inputs.label: Public Only
inputs.hint: If true, only include public replies — internal notes are excluded from the thread and from Last Comment.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.label: Limit
inputs.hint: Maximum number of most-recent comments to include; paginates automatically to satisfy this. Hard safety cap of 1000. Defaults to 100 if left unset.

outputs.name: thread_text
outputs.label: Thread Text
outputs.hint: The conversation as one formatted transcript, oldest to newest, e.g. "[2026-07-30 14:02] Jane Agent (public): ...".

outputs.name: comment_count
outputs.label: Comment Count
outputs.hint: Count of comments included in Thread Text, after applying Public Only and Limit.

outputs.name: last_comment_body
outputs.label: Last Comment Body
outputs.hint: The most recent comment's text, subject to Public Only filtering.
